newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy govt to call 23rd confidence vote Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Italy govt to call 23rd confidence vote Tuesday.

text.p: The Italian government intends to call a confidence vote in parliament later on Tuesday on a draft law aimed at speeding up the approval process for starting construction programmes, a government source said.

The move, aimed at sweeping away some 400 amendments tabled by the separatist Northern League, would be the government's 23rd confidnce vote since Prime Minister Romano Prodi's centre-left coalition took office a year ago.
The source said the decision will be officially announced in the lower house when the parliamentary sitting resumed at 1300 GMT.
The decree law would create special authorities to streamline the approval process for starting or resuming public works. The upper house has already approved the measure.
